title: Is the wiki disabled?
body: Clicking on the Wiki tab seems to reload the code page. Is the wiki page disabled? Is there another wiki? If so, should the wiki tab redirect to that?

comments.body:
There isn't a wiki. The only documentation is in the Documentation folder:

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/tree/master/Documentation
Maybe you can disable the Wiki button? If there is a Wiki tab regardless, can it redirect to the documentation folder?
I created a wiki site that simply links the documentation folder.
